topicName: Manifold Learning and Anomaly Detection: t-SNE, IsolationForest, and LocalOutlierFactor
content:
[{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"Manifold Learning and Anomaly Detection: t-SNE, IsolationForest, and LocalOutlierFactor in Scikit-learn"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"High-dimensional datasets present unique challenges for machine learning, often suffering from the curse of dimensionality. Visualizing and detecting anomalies in such spaces requires specialized techniques. In this tutorial, we explore how to combine Manifold Learning with unsupervised anomaly detection using Scikit-learn."},{"order":3,"type":"subheading","text":"Theoretical Overview"},{"order":4,"type":"bullet_point","text":"t-SNE (t-Distributed Stochastic Neighbor Embedding): A non-linear dimensionality reduction technique well-suited for embedding high-dimensional data into a low-dimensional space of two or three dimensions for visualization."},{"order":5,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Isolation Forest: An ensemble-based anomaly detection algorithm that explicitly isolates anomalies instead of profiling normal data points, making it efficient for high-dimensional datasets."},{"order":6,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Local Outlier Factor (LOF): A density-based algorithm that computes the local density deviation of a given data point with respect to its neighbors, identifying regions of similar density as normal and significantly lower densities as anomalies."},{"order":7,"type":"subheading","text":"Setting Up the Environment"},{"order":8,"type":"paragraph","text":"First, ensure you have the required libraries installed. We will use NumPy, Matplotlib, and Scikit-learn for our implementation and visualization."},{"order":9,"type":"code","text":"import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn.datasets import make_blobs
from sklearn.manifold import TSNE
from sklearn.ensemble import IsolationForest
from sklearn.neighbors import LocalOutlierFactor"},{"order":10,"type":"subheading","text":"Generating Synthetic High-Dimensional Data"},{"order":11,"type":"paragraph","text":"Let us generate a synthetic dataset with clusters and deliberately inject some random noise to act as our anomalies."},{"order":12,"type":"code","text":"np.random.seed(42)
X, _ = make_blobs(n_samples=300, n_features=10, centers=3, cluster_std=1.0, random_state=42)
# Inject anomalies
outliers = np.random.uniform(low=-10, high=10, size=(20, 10))
X_combined = np.vstack([X, outliers])
y_true = np.ones(len(X_combined))
y_true[-20:] = -1  # -1 for anomalies in Scikit-learn convention"},{"order":13,"type":"subheading","text":"Detecting Anomalies with Isolation Forest and LOF"},{"order":14,"type":"paragraph","text":"We will fit both IsolationForest and LocalOutlierFactor to the high-dimensional dataset to predict anomalies."},{"order":15,"type":"code","text":"iso_forest = IsolationForest(contamination=0.06, random_state=42)
preds_ifo = iso_forest.fit_predict(X_combined)

lof = LocalOutlierFactor(n_neighbors=20, contamination=0.06)
preds_lof = lof.fit_predict(X_combined)"},{"order":16,"type":"subheading","text":"Dimensionality Reduction via t-SNE"},{"order":17,"type":"paragraph","text":"Because we cannot easily plot 10-dimensional data, we apply t-SNE to project the data down to 2 dimensions. This allows us to visualize both the clusters and how well our anomaly detectors performed."},{"order":18,"type":"code","text":"tsne = TSNE(n_components=2, perplexity=30, random_state=42)
X_embedded = tsne.fit_transform(X_combined)"},{"order":19,"type":"subheading","text":"Visualizing the Results"},{"order":20,"type":"paragraph","text":"Finally, we plot the t-SNE projection and highlight the anomalies detected by Isolation Forest and Local Outlier Factor."},{"order":21,"type":"code","text":"plt.figure(figsize=(12, 5))

plt.subplot(1, 2, 1)
plt.scatter(X_embedded[:, 0], X_embedded[:, 1], c=preds_ifo, cmap='coolwarm', edgecolor='k', s=40)
plt.title('Isolation Forest Predictions')

plt.subplot(1, 2, 2)
plt.scatter(X_embedded[:, 0], X_embedded[:, 1], c=preds_lof, cmap='coolwarm', edgecolor='k', s=40)
plt.title('Local Outlier Factor Predictions')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()"},{"order":22,"type":"subheading","text":"Conclusion"},{"order":23,"type":"paragraph","text":"By combining t-SNE with anomaly detection algorithms like Isolation Forest and LOF, practitioners can both identify outliers in high-dimensional space and visually inspect the efficacy of their models in a 2D plane."}]
